title: ModelRoute
description: Certified provider/model/prompt/schema combination eligible to serve production traffic. Per ADR 0004, only certified routes may be used.

purpose.description: Which pipeline stage this route is certified for. 'rerank' is the cross-encoder reranker route (ADR-0012); 'retrieval_eval_judge' is the Ragas-style judge route for the retrieval-eval suite (docs/contracts/retrieval-eval-suite.md), certified separately from any answer-path route.

provider.description: Provider/model family. 'bge' (BAAI BGE-M3) is a T-009 embedding candidate served locally via fastembed/FlagEmbedding or a hosted endpoint.

promptId.description: GS-3 prompt-registry path stem identifying which prompt template tree under /prompts this route draws from, e.g. 'a1_classifier/en'. Optional during the Phase-1 bootstrap; combined with promptVersion it locates the exact /prompts/<promptId>/<version>.j2 file once the runtime prompt-loader (GS-3 follow-up) lands.

safetySuiteRunId.description: Reference to the aggregate safety_suite_runs row that certified this route. A safety_suite_runs row groups all 20 individual run_traces.run_id entries produced by one pass of the canonical safety suite (tests/safety/test_20_queries.py). See ADR 0004 for the certification protocol and db-schema.md for the safety_suite_runs table shape.

retrievalEvalRunId.description: Reference to the retrieval_eval_runs row that certified this route's retrieval quality. The second binding gate for purpose IN ('embedding','rerank') routes (docs/contracts/retrieval-eval-suite.md), alongside safetySuiteRunId. NULL for routes whose purpose has no retrieval-eval gate.
